description: This file contains interface and class definitions related to broadcast channel subscribers within the Orleans framework, including base classes and specific subscriber grain implementations using implicit channel subscriptions.

classes.name: SubscriberGrainBase
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing common subscriber behavior, managing received values, errors, and subscription logic.

classes.name: SimpleSubscriberGrain
classes.description: Concrete class representing a simple subscriber with implicit channel subscription.

classes.name: RegexNamespaceSubscriberGrain
classes.description: Concrete class representing a regex-based namespace subscriber with implicit channel subscription.

methods.name: GetErrors
methods.description: Retrieves errors received for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves values received for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: GetOnPublishedCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of how many times the OnPublished method has been called.

methods.name: ThrowsOnReceive
methods.description: Sets the flag to throw an exception upon receiving a message.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles subscription event, attaching handlers for received items and errors.
